ruling.explanation: To the rider: your fare has been checked line by line. The GPS trace measures the trip at 4.05 km against the booked optimal route of 3.2 km — an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.6% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests are met (more than 0.8 km in absolute terms and more than 20% of optimal), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED and the route driven was longer than needed. The trace, not the rounded trip-record copy of 4.0 km, is the governing figure. Rerunning the METERED fare on the optimal route under POL-RD-02 gives ((3.80 base + 0.75 × 3.2 km + 0.28 × 6.0 min) × 1.0 surge, read from the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 8.68. Charged total was SGD 9.28, so the refund is 9.28 − 8.68 = SGD 0.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis floor, so it is not NO_ACTION, and it is only 6.5% of the charge, far below the 90% full-refund share, so it is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 0.60 and your fare is reduced to SGD 8.68. The monetary effect (SGD 0.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. To the driver: the excess is measured on this trip's own trace, which is clean for policy purposes (37 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 does not fire and no independent corroboration was required. Your explanation 'Followed the app.' names no clause and cites no evidence, so under POL-RD-08 it discharges nothing. No traffic advisory covers the trip window — EV-ADVIS-02822-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 — so any external-traffic excuse is weightless under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13(2), and because no surviving claim or party statement cited that identifier, the missing artifact is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction that would trigger POL-RD-10(5). You are not out of pocket beyond the fare adjustment, and no driver compensation is due: the distance billed (4.0 km) falls short of the 4.05 km driven by only 0.05 km, well under the 1.0 km POL-RD-04 threshold. On the remaining points: POL-RD-04 is unavailable (the chat log holds zero messages, so there is no rider instruction or waypoint), POL-RD-05 is unavailable (no pickup or dropoff amendment, amended_optimal_distance_km null), POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL), POL-RD-09 shows no ERP, toll or surcharge lines to correct or double-count, and POL-RD-06 is not triggered because the deviation is not MATERIAL (0.85 km is under 8.0 km and 26.6% is under 50%), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Neither party's profile raises the corroboration bar (rider deviation_claims_60d is 0) or establishes a repeat-deviation pattern (driver deviation_flags_90d is 1 against 402 completed trips). Evidence discarded on the citation check: two claims — one from each side — that relied on the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02822-01 without disclosing its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code, discarded under POL-GEN-02(1); their substance is answered above on the surviving record.
